title: Per-firm re-evaluation of C* + BTC leads with each firm's own rules, costs and day boundaries
registered: 2026-10-14, before any Gen55 result was computed
strategy: C* + BTC leads (Gen53), vol lookback 30, no band, 15% vol scaling on DEV; fixed, not re-tuned
firms: every crypto preset in qpl.lab.propfirms (17) + FTMO swap stress (swap 3.3 bp/day, since FTMO crypto swaps are unknown)
firm_conditions: cost_bps per side on turnover, swap_bps_day on gross notional, leverage cap (sum |w|/lev <= 1, rows scaled down), day reset hour, payout minimum, first-payout delay
selection: per firm, the grid point with the highest mean 24-month net (budget 5 challenges, 1 account) on DEV 2018-03-05..2022-12-31 using the daily-candle model with the firm's costs
evaluation: hourly replay on Binance hourly prices 2022-01..2026-10 for (a) the common baseline 1.0/0.4/no stop and (b) the DEV pick; reported: pass rate, P(funded), mean / median / p10 net, P(profit), months 7-24 with net income
trials_note: 18 firm rows x 24 grid points = 432 configurations evaluated on DEV; the strategy itself is not re-selected, so the strategy trial count is unchanged; firm ranking is a choice among 18
caveats: fees for Breakout and BrightFunded One-Step, all payout cadences not given by the user, splits for Breakout/FundedNext and most cost levels are ASSUMED (marked in each preset's note); hourly 2022 overlaps DEV
